newsitem.title: USA: Cellegy starts testing wrinkle product.
newsitem.headline: Cellegy starts testing wrinkle product.

text.p: Cellegy Pharmaceuticals Inc said it began clinical testing of a product to reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles in photodamaged and aging skin.
The trials are intended to optimize earlier tests which demonstrated the product's ability to reduce wrinkles without causing stinging, reddening or irritation of treated skin.

"Cellegy's anti-wrinkling product is expected to display triple-action benefits, in that it produces in one substance the benefits of three different structural classes of compounds with known anti-aging and anti-wrinkling activity," said Dr. Carl Thornfeldt, Cellegy's founder and chairman.
